data.title: bn-14o: Capture immutable Teapot accounting observations
data.description: Review the passive accounting argv, approved pass and engine identity checks, preservation of nullable counters and native diagnostics, rejection of counter discontinuities, and refusal to attribute a debit or a native job to a Scourge run without matching receipts.

data.body: HIGH: A missing request-counter row at exactly one endpoint is treated as CounterDiscontinuity, so finish returns no AccountingV1 record instead of preserving the known endpoint and null at the other. The bone explicitly requires before and after counters each to be independently nullable; a temporary missing row is not positive evidence of a reset. The existing test explicitly expects refusal for Some -> None, so it misses this acceptance case. Preserve the nullable endpoints and only compare values when both observations exist; test both directions and retain unestablished attribution and no charge.

data.reason: HIGH th-3ntkk0: one-sided absent counters prevent the required nullable accounting record.

data.body: Fixed. Before and after request-counter rows now project independently. An absent endpoint stays null, and continuity checks compare only values observed at both endpoints. Both asymmetric cases verify the present count’s artifact, observation window, source, unit, and granularity, and preserve unestablished attribution with no run charge. Tests also cover wrong pass identity, duplicate and malformed rows, and a different meter claiming run granularity. All 13 focused tests, both pinned Teapot tests, and full just check passed.

data.reason: Verified both asymmetric endpoints remain nullable with original count provenance, no charge, and unestablished attribution; focused tests pass.
Reviewed full range and corrected independent nullable counters; focused invocation tests pass. Pinned and full host checks reported by author; sandbox denies socket creation.

Full synced range reviewed: accounting commits range-diff identical to previously approved change; checkpoint preserves original review history. Focused suite 13 passed and diff check clean. An intermittent wrapper diagnostic failure was reported on the host and passed on unchanged retry; the wrapper and process paths are unchanged by sync, and cause is not established. Pinned and full host checks reported by author.
